    downside = adj_usa_injury_seth_jones + adj_canada_strength + adj_tournament_format_variance + adj_other_risks_and_field_strength

    shock_scale = abs(adj_tournament_format_variance) + abs(adj_other_risks_and_field_strength) + ONE
    matchup_scale = abs(adj_canada_strength) + ONE
    team_scale = abs(upside) + abs(adj_usa_injury_seth_jones) + ONE

    scaled_downside = downside / (shock_scale + matchup_scale)

    combined_shift = scaled_upside + scaled_downside

    shifted_log_odds = base_log_odds + combined_shift
    model_probability = logistic(shifted_log_odds)

    interval_center = (interval_lower_bound + interval_upper_bound) / TWO
    interval_mass = abs(interval_lower_bound) + abs(interval_upper_bound)

    prior_mass = abs(previous_forecast_probability)
    prior_pull = abs(model_probability - previous_forecast_probability)

    anchor_weight = prior_mass / (prior_mass + prior_pull + ONE)
    interval_weight = interval_mass / (interval_mass + ONE)
    model_weight = abs(net_signal) + ONE

    total_weight = model_weight + anchor_weight + interval_weight
    blended_probability = (model_probability * model_weight + previous_forecast_probability * anchor_weight + interval_center * interval_weight) / total_weight
